name: thread-headers
description: Threading headers of replies. Two messages are seeded in the POP3 inbox (a root message and a follow-up in the same thread). replyToMessage with skipReview is allowed for this scenario only (blockSkipReview = false), so each reply is delivered to the local mailpit sink inside the container, where its raw headers are inspected: In-Reply-To and References must point at the replied message, the subject gets a single Re: prefix, the reply goes to the original sender and quotes the original text.

messages:
From: Alice Example <alice@example.com>
To: Lab User <lab@example.test>
Subject: Lab thread root [t1]
Date: Thu, 01 Jan 2026 10:00:00 +0000
Message-ID: <thread-root@example.com>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Original line of the root message.
From: Bob Example <bob@example.com>
To: Lab User <lab@example.test>
Subject: Re: Lab thread follow-up [t2]
Date: Thu, 01 Jan 2026 11:00:00 +0000
Message-ID: <thread-follow-up@example.com>
In-Reply-To: <thread-root@example.com>
References: <thread-root@example.com>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Original line of the follow-up.

steps.note: Seeded mbox files have no .msf summary; running the (empty) filter list over the folder makes Thunderbird parse it.

arguments.body: Lab reply to the root message.

checks.subject: [t1]
checks.contains: Lab reply to the root message.

checks.subject: [t1]
checks.contains: > Original line of the root message.
